title: Case: Business sender needs collection of several labelled cartons
context: A business shipper needs capacity for four labelled cartons. Collection planning controls vehicle allocation and manifest acceptance.
initial_request: Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.

events.from: Dervla Eckersall, Calloway Fold Studio shipping coordinator
events.body:
Inline packing list OF-2701: 4 labelled cartons, each 40 × 30 × 25 cm and 5 kg, total 20 kg; labels DL-7967-A through DL-7967-D. Ready at dispatch door S1 from 10:00 UTC on 2028-03-07.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-642.txt

events.from: Dervla Eckersall, Calloway Fold Studio shipping coordinator
events.body: Could you confirm a collection vehicle can take all four together? We cannot release a partial consignment.

attachments.name: label-scan-642.txt
attachments.text:

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection planner to confirm capacity for the stated carton count, sizes and weights.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Heronwick Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection planner to confirm capacity for the stated carton count, sizes and weights. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Capacity reservation and accepted manifest do not prove collection.
Treats label-scan-642.txt as evidence about DL-7967: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-62448)
Tells anyone that DL-7967 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-642.txt
expected.reference_message: Please confirm capacity for all four cartons on OF-2701: each 40 × 30 × 25 cm, 5 kg; total 20 kg. Request collection 2028-03-07 from 10:00 UTC, dispatch door S1. Accept A–D as one manifest.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-036: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-642.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-62448); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
